name: Osanai Takashi
source:
Chika's husband.

He is the homeroom teacher of 2-A at Haidari-Nishi Daini Junior High School and a science teacher.

His parents live in Saitama and he is the second son. He is an indoor person. He is basically mild-mannered.

According to his wife, “He is just indecisive and not good at expressing his feelings. Tends to forget anniversaries. Loves Chika.

[from [url=http://autobahn69.jp/Autobahn/buai.html] official site]
